content:
**Brahmin Milk** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

## Gameplay[edit]

A wooden bucket filled with milk collected from a Brahmin. It can be consumed raw to satisfy a negligible amount of hunger and thirst while healing a small amount of HP and rads. It can also be used as an ingredient in various recipes for additional benefits.

## Variant[edit]

## Locations[edit]

Up to five can be obtained by milking a Brahmin, including ones at a Fertilizer Producer. Fixed spawn locations for brahmin include:

- Four in Flatwoods, in the center of the town, near the church on the left side.
 - These brahmin may be found already dead, having been killed by the ghouls living nearby.
- Three outside the Wayward, in the pen on the right hand side.
- Three at Big Bend Tunnel East, direcly in front of the fast travel point.
- Three due east of Pleasant Valley Station, at the shore of a lake.
- Three in the Brahmin Wrangler random encounter.
- Two at Anchor Farm, in the pen on the right hand side of the house.
- One at Lewis & Sons Farming Supply, in the pen near the greenhouse.
- One at Big Bend Tunnel West, behind a building on the left hand side upon entrance of the compound.
- One at Foundation, to the north off the cliff, at the corner of the fence and the monorail.
 - This brahmin may be found already dead, as there is an assault random encounter spawn point nearby.
- Three brahmin appear during the Event: Free Range event.
- Two appear during the Activity: Riding Shotgun event.
- Minos, the brahmin accompanying Minerva at the Crater, Foundation or Fort Atlas, can also be milked.

- Brahmin can be milked once every 30 minutes, but only by one person per server.
- Brahmin Milk cannot be sold to vendors.

![Playstation 4](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6f/Icon_ps4.png/18px-Icon_ps4.png) It is possible to milk brahmin from great distances by using a scoped weapon.
